blocks.text: Layered persons and rooms impress slightly displaced copies on a visitor.
Appearance: Godot draws three translucent copies of the current pet frame in different directions. Reduced motion holds them still.
Care: Targeted chronic treatment; rest alone does not cure the condition.
Story connection: A future encounter could ask which copy remembers an unfinished kindness.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Story-established, with uncertain ontology.
